Prompt

Create A/B testing page variants:

1. CONTROL VERSION (A)
Baseline page:
- Current best performer
- Standard layout
- Proven elements
- Benchmark metrics

2. HEADLINE VARIANTS
Test different angles:
- Benefit-focused: "Get [Result] in [Time]"
- Problem-focused: "Stop [Pain Point] Forever"
- Question-based: "Want to [Achieve Goal]?"
- Social proof: "Join [X] People Who..."
- Urgency: "Last Chance to [Action]"

3. SUBHEADLINE TESTS
Supporting copy:
- Feature-focused
- Benefit-focused
- Objection-handling
- Social proof
- Specificity test

4. CTA BUTTON VARIANTS
Button copy tests:
- "Get Started" vs "Start Free Trial"
- "Download Now" vs "Get My Copy"
- "Sign Up" vs "Create Account"
- First person: "Start My Free Trial"
- Urgency: "Claim Your Spot"

5. CTA BUTTON DESIGN
Visual tests:
- Color variations
- Size differences
- Rounded vs square
- With/without icon
- Shadow/no shadow

6. LAYOUT VARIATIONS
Structure tests:
- Image left vs right
- Video vs static image
- Long form vs short
- Single column vs two
- Above fold content

7. SOCIAL PROOF PLACEMENT
Position tests:
- Below headline
- Near CTA button
- In hero section
- Dedicated section
- Floating element

8. FORM VARIATIONS
Field tests:
- Email only
- Email + name
- Email + company
- Multi-step form
- Inline vs popup

9. TRUST ELEMENT TESTS
- With/without badges
- Testimonial types
- Logo variations
- Guarantee placement
- Security indicators

10. URGENCY TESTS
- With/without timer
- Scarcity messaging
- Limited time offers
- Stock indicators
- Deadline copy

11. IMAGE TESTS
Visual variations:
- Product shots
- People using product
- Before/after
- Illustrations
- Screenshots

12. PRICING DISPLAY
If applicable:
- Price shown vs hidden
- Monthly vs annual
- With/without discount
- Comparison table
- Value framing

Testing guidelines:
- Test one element at a time
- Run until statistical significance
- Minimum 100 conversions per variant
- Test for at least 2 weeks
- Document all tests

Variant structure:
Create 3-5 versions with:
- Version A: Control (current best)
- Version B: Headline change
- Version C: CTA change
- Version D: Layout change
- Version E: Combined winners

Metrics to track:
- Conversion rate
- Bounce rate
- Time on page
- Scroll depth
- Click heatmaps
- Form abandonment

Implementation notes:
- Use same URL with query params
- Ensure proper tracking
- Random traffic split
- Mobile/desktop parity
- Page load consistency
